transcript:
**Agent:** Thank you for calling Tech Solutions, this is Sarah speaking. How can I assist you today?

**Customer:** Hi Sarah, I’m having some trouble with my billing. I noticed I was charged twice last month.

**Agent:** I’m sorry to hear that, I can help you with this. Can you provide me with your account email address so I can look into the charges?

**Customer:** Sure, it’s john.doe@example.com. 

**Agent:** Thank you, John. Just a moment while I check your billing details. 

**Customer:** No problem. I’m actually on the Basic plan, but I thought it was supposed to be a flat rate.

**Agent:** I see where the confusion might be. There’s a billing cycle adjustment that occurred, which may have triggered an extra charge. I’ll get to the bottom of this right now.

**Customer:** That would be great, because right now it's really frustrating.

**Agent:** I understand. It looks like you were charged for an additional service that was added during your free trial period. I can assist you with reversing that charge.

**Customer:** That’s a relief. Thank you! Can you also tell me if there are any upgrades available? I might be interested in more features.

**Agent:** Absolutely! Our Pro plan offers enhanced analytics and priority support. Would you like me to send you a comparison of the features?

**Customer:** Yes, please. That sounds good.

**Agent:** I’ll also include a promo code for the first month. You'll receive that email shortly, John.

**Customer:** Thank you so much, Sarah. You’ve been really helpful!

**Agent:** My pleasure, John! If you have any more questions or need further assistance, just give us a call. Have a great day!

**Customer:** You too! Bye!
